motivation: After the demand-support and within-listing checks, compare contemporaneous price with predetermined previous fresh quote. Official Swappa negotiation workflow permits price changes following an offer; direction of causality remains uncertain.
sample: Corrected current one-day sample with previous fresh quote on immediately preceding calendar day. Evaluate all specifications on the same rows.
method: Descriptive absorbed linear probability models, same continuous covariates, two-way category/date clusters. Changing lagged prices is a predictor contrast, not the causal effect of changing current prices.
raw_summary: Compare sale rates on isolated and coordinated price-change dates, conditioning only on contemporaneous and past observations. No future-price placebo conditioned on listing survival.
